hypotheses.H1_head_recomposition_is_exact: The six native head deltas recompose the changed final-destination write with relative L2 error at most 1e-6 and propagated-logit disagreement at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.H2_two_behavior_selected_heads_are_usefu: Every frozen layerwise two-head program has held-out Fisher fidelity at least 0.50 in every corpus-by-distance condition.
hypotheses.H3_three_behavior_selected_heads_are_nea: Every frozen layerwise three-head program has held-out Fisher fidelity at least 0.85.
hypotheses.H4_behavior_selection_beats_state_select: At head budgets two and three, behavior-selected programs exceed state-selected programs by at least 0.05 mean held-out Fisher fidelity.
hypotheses.H5_head_program_transfers_ood: At budget three, each layer's OOD mean fidelity is within 0.15 of its held-out FineWeb mean.
hypotheses.H6_previously_recurrent_heads_are_select: The behavior-selected two-head sets contain Layer-5 Head-2, Layer-6 Head-5, Layer-8 Head-3, and Layer-10 Head-0.
hypotheses.H7_native_head_program_is_sparse: Behavior-selected two-head programs have at least 0.80 mean held-out Fisher fidelity.
hypotheses.H8_four_heads_are_sufficient: Behavior-selected four-head programs have at least 0.95 held-out Fisher fidelity in every condition.
hypotheses.H9_selected_output_subspaces_are_weight_: Adjacent selected two-head output subspaces have overlap at or above the 90th percentile of all matched-size head-pair choices.
